title: رفع مشروع Next.js على VPS بنفسك: Docker و HTTPS من غير Vercel
description:
رفع مشروع Next.js على VPS بنفسك، خطوة خطوة: output standalone، و Dockerfile على تلاتة مراحل، و compose فيه healthcheck، و HTTPS مع Caddy، و DNS على Cloudflare.
وفي الآخر: إزاي ترجع لو حاجة باظت، وأول خمس حاجات تأمّن بيها السيرفر.

Devya: https://www.devya.dev/solutions?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=yt-nextjs-vps-without-vercel&utm_content=long
تواصل معانا: https://www.devya.dev/contact?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=yt-nextjs-vps-without-vercel&utm_content=long

next.config.ts:
output: 'standalone'

Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml ./
RUN corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
RUN corepack enable && pnpm build
FROM node:22-alpine AS run
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000
COPY --from=build /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=build /app/.next/static ./.next/static
COPY --from=build /app/public ./public
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

Caddyfile:
shop.example.com {
  reverse_proxy web:3000
}

Deploy a Next.js app to your own VPS without Vercel: standalone output, a three-stage Dockerfile, compose with a healthcheck, automatic HTTPS with Caddy, Cloudflare DNS, rollbacks and day-one hardening.
